label: respondent identifier
construction: 2011 files use an 11-character ID; conv11() restores the 12-character form

label: grip strength 2011
construction: maximum of four trials; 0/993/999 and >80 kg set to missing

label: any ADL limitation 2011
construction: 1 if any of six items scored 3 or 4

label: any ADL limitation 2013
construction: as above; the landmark eligibility variable

label: ADL inability 2018
construction: 1 only if an item scored 4 (stricter definition)

label: ADL or IADL limitation 2018
construction: any of eleven items scored 3 or 4

label: education
construction: 6 raw levels collapsed to five categories

label: body mass index 2013
construction: weight/(height/100)^2; implausible values set to missing

label: chronic conditions
construction: count of conditions; missing if fewer than 10 items answered

label: depressive symptoms 2013
construction: ten items; dc013 and dc016 reverse-scored; rescaled to ten items when >=8 answered (range 0-30)

label: low grip 2011 (AWGS 2025)
construction: <34/<20 kg at ages 50-64 and <28/<18 kg at 65+

label: three-category outcome
construction: 0 alive and ADL-free 1 ADL disability 2 death
